data.exact_reserve_text: The release during 2015 on outstanding claims net of claims paid as at 31 December 2014 was GBP 14,497,316 with a further release of risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provision ("ULAE") of GBP 11,655,032 due to claims being settled resulting in a total improvement of GBP 26,152,348.

prior_year_events.event_name: Aggregate Excess of Loss reinsurance contract (TPRe)
prior_year_events.impact_description: Reinsurance contract purchased covering losses insured in underwriting years 2010 to 2014 for a premium of GBP 60m, reducing reserve risk and improving return on equity.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross release of GBP 11.244 million in prior year reserves, primarily due to favorable claims development for underwriting years 2011, 2012, and 2013, as calculated from the gross claims development triangle. A net improvement of GBP 26.152 million was also reported, including releases from risk margin and unallocated loss adjustment expense provisions due to claims being settled. Additionally, an Aggregate Excess of Loss reinsurance contract was purchased covering underwriting years 2010-2014 to reduce reserve risk.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior_year_development_gbp_m is derived from the gross claims development triangle for underwriting years 2011-2013. The narrative in Note 7 describes a net improvement of GBP 26.152m including risk margin and ULAE, which is not directly comparable to the gross claims triangle. The gross_premium_mix sum from the segmental analysis table is GBP 393.676m, which is GBP 0.001m higher than the gross_premiums_written_gbp_m of GBP 393.675m from the Statement of Comprehensive Income, likely due to rounding.
